title: A refused save closes the confirmation and saves nothing
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SAVEFAIL-01), with Sell Price $20.00, is stocked at {Location-A}.
  • Another Part Library entry, {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SAVEFAIL-02), is stocked at {Location-B} only.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, type {Part-A} in the search on the Active tab.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with {Part-B}, typed exactly.
  4. Change the Sell Price to 25.00.
  5. Click the Inactive option.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Click Deactivate.
  8. Click Cancel on the part window.
  9. Type {Part-A} in the search on the Active tab.
  10. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: "Deactivate part?" opens.
  • Step 7: the confirmation closes, and the part window shows the refusal "Part number {Part-B} already belongs to another part in the Part Library."
  • Step 9: {Part-A} is still on the Active tab, still numbered {Part-A}.
  • Step 10: Sell Price reads $20.00: nothing was saved.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-N5, S13-N1, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.3 (Save asks first), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-N5: “If saving the form is refused while the confirmation is open, the confirmation closes, the dialog shows the refusal, and nothing is saved.”
  • S13-N1: “If another Part Library entry already has exactly the typed number, with the same characters and the same upper and lower case, the save is refused, the dialog stays open, and the system shows "Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library."”
